cohort: Twelve patients aged between 24-54 years with iatrogenic ureteric injuries managed at urology units in the Volta region of Ghana between 2015-2021.
finding: Open hysterectomy (83.7%) was the most common procedure leading to iatrogenic ureteric injuries, and intra-operative recognition of the injury was more common when the surgery was performed by specialist surgeons.
mod_finding: Emergency caesarean section was implicated in one instance of iatrogenic ureteric injury (16.7%).
